situation:
You are the distribution manager at NORTH SHORE SPORTS AUDIO, a sports podcast and media network and the regional leader in its home market. The network president (judge) has asked you to recommend where the network's flagship show is carried as the company expands into its first out-of-state market, and to say what that choice does to the audience the show already has.

The flagship covers the state university football team, which finished the season with two wins and ten losses. Downloads on the open podcast feed have fallen by a third since October, and two advertisers on that feed have declined to renew. The network is entering three cities in the next state, and it is doing that through an affiliate agreement with a radio group that simulcasts the flagship in every one of them.

A national streaming platform has offered to pay for the flagship, on the condition that it becomes exclusive to the platform's app in the three new cities. The affiliate agreement with the radio group requires the flagship to stay on the open feed the radio group simulcasts. Both contracts are in force, a rival network already sells advertising in two of those cities, and the network cannot satisfy both agreements.

Moving the flagship behind the streaming platform's app brings paid subscribers in a market the network has never sold in, and it breaks the affiliate agreement with the radio group that carries the network in all three cities. Staying on the open feed keeps the radio group and its listeners, and the network then enters those cities on advertising revenue that the losing season is still pulling down, with only its email list to sell subscriptions against.

The network president (judge) wants your recommendation on where the flagship is carried in the three new cities, what the choice means for the listeners who follow the show on the open feed, and what the network would say to the partner it disappoints. The network president (judge) will greet you in the office and ask to hear your ideas. After you have presented and answered the questions, the network president (judge) will thank you for your work.

You have asked the distribution manager (participant) to recommend where the flagship is carried in the three new cities, to say what the choice means for the listeners on the open feed, and to explain what the network would say to the partner it disappoints.
